_comment: Exact git refs (tag or SHA) of pine-lang and beamlynx-ui bundled into this desktop build. Checked out directly by CI via these refs -- update deliberately as part of a release, per RELEASING.md. pine-lang bumped to its tagged 0.53.0 (rows from JSON arrays with unnest:, joins on names given with as); beamlynx-ui bumped to its tagged 0.72.0 (unnest on the canvas, data masking on the Agent page). beamlynx-ui 0.72.0 needs pine-lang 0.53 (its RequiredVersion).
